messages.author: c621ac38989fbf3c
messages.subject: kriging
parts:
Hi Paul,
 Was wondering if you might implement Bayesian kriging for spatial data in brms.
 I haven't found many references for it with Stan, but it's certainly been used with MCMC methods.

https://aheblog.com/2016/12/07/geostatistical-modelling-with-r-and-stan/

Thanks,
Paul

messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Re: [brms-users] kriging
parts:
Krigings is just a synonym to Gaussian processes and that's already possible via gp() terms. Be aware that GPs scale badly with the number of observations,
so for more than a few hundred observations I strongly recommend using splines instead.
